decisions.reason: The coffee-based men's series uses the firm's long experience with certified natural formulations, but it targets a new customer segment where the firm has less market knowledge, so early results are harder to read and the risk of dropping it is moderate rather than low.

The cleansing foam extends the established Sandorini series and sits squarely within the firm's existing formulation and customer knowledge, so the firm can easily assimilate feedback and keep refining it.
